connector.name: droplinked
connector.registryDescription: Agentic commerce + trust MCP: discover, verify, and transact across droplinked's merchant network.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.droplinked.com over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.droplinked.mcp. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-MCP-API-Key
headers.description: droplinked MCP API key. Required for non-read-only tools (process_payment, start_checkout, request_brand_attestation, report_repayment, etc.). Read-only discovery + verification tools (find_merchant, find_inventory, search_products, get_product, list_shop_products, verify_brand_attestation, get_feed) work without one. Request a key from ops@droplinked.com.
